resource.name: consultant-skills-servicenow
resource.description: The register of consultant skills: the skill catalogue, and a search for the consultants who hold a given set of skills, used to staff an engagement.
resource.provider: ServiceNow, the organization's instance, through its "find consultants by skills" scripted REST API

config.description: Client id for the client-credentials grant
Client secret for the client-credentials grant
Token address for the client-credentials grant
Base address of the scripted REST API on the ServiceNow instance

resource.consumptionInstructions: Authenticate with OAuth2 client credentials against the token address and send the bearer token on every call. Two operations, both under `/find_consultants_by_skills`: `GET …/skills` returns the catalogue as `{ result: [ { sys_id, skill } ] }`; `POST …/consultants` with `{ engagementID: <number>, skill_ids: [<sys_id>] }` returns `{ result: { consultants: [ { sys_id, name, email, skills: [<skill name>] } ] } }`. Every response is wrapped in `result`. Skill ids are ServiceNow system ids and opaque; show the `skill` name, send the `sys_id`. The search can be slow: the current app allows a long timeout and retries server errors a few times.
